_readme: External references for `npm run visual:ref` (scripts/visual-ref.mjs). Each entry: name, file (PNG in this folder, exported from Figma or captured from the real app — never from the kit), source (where it came from + date), route (+ params) and select (CSS selectors whose union box is captured), viewport (the reference's screen width), scale (px per CSS px of the PNG), optional refCrop [x, y, w, h] and masks [[x, y, w, h], …] in reference CSS px (data that legitimately differs: prices, counts), threshold (max share of differing pixels) and sizeTolerance (px).
